name: OnReportFileName
caption: When a report file name is generated

configuration.description: Report lines: [{ "reportId": <integer>, "tableNo": <integer, 0 = none> }]. The flow runs only for these reports. tableNo is the report's source table; when it is > 0 the matched records are exposed as the Rec_<reportId> reference output. Keep each reportId on one line only: when a report is listed twice, the first line is used.

Seconds the flow may run inside the report request. Checked between steps: once it has passed, the remaining steps do not run and Business Central keeps the name it generated. 0 or a negative value means no limit.

outputs.name: ProposedFileName
outputs.when: always; the file name Business Central generated

outputs.name: Extension
outputs.when: always; file extension as passed by Business Central (verbatim)

outputs.name: RecordCount
outputs.when: always; number of records the output covers (true total, may exceed the emitted references), 0 when there is no source record

outputs.name: Rec_<reportId>
outputs.when: one per reports entry with tableNo > 0, in line order; name e.g. Rec_1306, tableNo = reports[].tableNo. At run time it points at the first matched record; Rec_<reportId>[0], [1], ... (max 1000) carry every matched record but are not declared in outputs. No record matched = the output is not set.

rules.check: configuration.reports must contain at least one entry. Raised while registering the trigger (after the licensing call), which undoes the whole publish.
rules.message: The "When a report file name is generated" trigger requires at least one report line.

rules.check: Only one published flow per environment may use this trigger. Registrations of deleted or unpublished flows are cleaned up automatically.
rules.message: Only one published flow can use the "When a report file name is generated" trigger. It is already used by flow '%1'.

rules.check: configuration.reports must be an array of objects. Anything else is read as no lines, so the publish fails with the 'requires at least one report line' error.
The registered flow's published version cannot be loaded. The error reaches the user and the report output fails.
rules.message: Failed to resolve trigger context for Report ID %1 (flow %2).

rules.check: Any error in the flow: the execution is marked Error with this log entry, Business Central keeps its own file name, and the output does not fail.
rules.message: Report file-name flow failed before any body step could complete: %1

rules.check: The flow runs synchronously, so a step that defers the run (Sleep) fails. The failure is handled like any other flow error (see runner-failed).
rules.message: Step %1 (%2) requested a deferred resume, but the flow is running synchronously. Use Sleep or other time-based deferral steps only outside of synchronous frames (Webhook sync phase or SubFlow body).

notes: Fires for any output type (PDF, Word, Excel, ...) from both file-name paths of Business Central: the platform path (Send to..., request-page Save/Download) and the legacy custom-layout path (Word-layout email, custom-layout SaveAs). If another extension already named the file on the platform path, the flow is not started.

Synchronous: the flow runs inside the user's request until a Set report file name step answers, the flow ends or fails, or timeoutSec has passed (checked between steps). Without an answer Business Central keeps its own name. Business Central removes characters that are not allowed in file names afterwards.
Re-entrancy guard: if the flow itself renders a report, that nested file-name event does not start the flow again.

Matched records: on the platform path the trigger reads the report's request-page filter for the line's tableNo and returns every matching record, up to 1000 references; RecordCount reports the true total. On the legacy path, or when no filter is available, only the record Business Central passes is used.
Single catch-all flow: one published flow per environment handles all configured reports. Branch on {{trigger_ReportId}}.

The trigger has its own configuration checks (at least one line, timeout of at least 1 second, report exists, table exists, report listed once), but 27.0.40 runs none of them in the editor or at publish. Only the publish-time 'at least one report line' check above is enforced. Use existing report and table numbers anyway: a line for a report that does not exist never fires.
No recurring Job Queue entry is created on publish.
Picker filter: Set report file name is ONLY offered in this trigger's flows. Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set document field values and Prevent page close are hidden.
